title: Chhattisgarh HC rejects plea against Gayatri Mantra in schools; says no bar on moral instructions
description: The Chhattisgarh High Court recently dismissed a petition challenging a June 12 State government circular directing the recital of Saraswati Vandana, Gayatri Mantra, Guru Mantra and other Hindu prayers in schools [Abdul Salam Rizvi & Ors. v State of Chhattisgarh & Ors.].Justice Amitendra Kishore Prasad dismissed the petition as premature, holding that the petitioners had failed to demonstrate any actual violation of fundamental rights or any instance of students being compelled to partic
